properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 16 at 10:53PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 1053 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm near
Pueblo West, or near Pueblo, moving east at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 40 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Pueblo, Pueblo Airport, Pueblo West, Salt Creek, Blende, and Pueblo
Reservoir.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 16 at 8:26PM MDT until August 16 at 11:30PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southeastern Lincoln County in east central Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 1130 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 826 PM MDT, the public reported flooding in the advisory
area due to thunderstorms earlier. Minor flooding is already
occurring. Between 2 and 4 inches of rain fell earlier.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Coon Creek, Rush Creek, Big Sandy Creek and Folger Gulch.
Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional rainfall is
expected.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Boyero.
